description: This file contains unit tests for the ModelForm class within the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model package. It verifies the creation and parsing of UpdateArea objects from JWT tokens, including handling parameters with JSON conversion.

classes.name: ModelFormTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ModelForm functionalities related to JWT token parsing and UpdateArea creation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and test data before each test.

methods.name: testCreateUpdateAreaFromJWTAreaValues
methods.description: Tests creation of UpdateArea from JWT token with basic areaId and areaTarget values.

methods.name: testCreateUpdateAreaFromJWTWithParametersMapString
methods.description: Tests creation of UpdateArea from JWT token with parameters included as a JSON string, verifying parameter parsing.
